Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rudal Singh, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Kalyan Shankar, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 3 30-01-2026 Heard the parties.

2. This is the second attempt of the petitioner for grant of regular bail in connection with Bypass P.S.
Case No. 04 of 2023 registered for the offence under Section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4, 6 and 8 of the POCSO Act.
Earlier the bail application of the petitioner was rejected vide order dated 03.05.2024 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 197 of 2024.
3. The petitioner is in custody since 15.01.2023.
4. As per the prosecution case, petitioner is accused of committing gang rape.
5. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that in the trial most of the witnesses have been Patna High Court CR.
